This is my main maize plot, small but it feeds my family, so I must take care of it well. I managed to get a FISP coupon this year, so I will use the fertilizer on the maize — that is where it matters most. I will also spread some manure from my goats before planting, and since the coupon comes with improved seed I will use that. The plot is small, so my wife and I can handle most of the work ourselves, but I may call a few ganyu workers for weeding when the rains come hard.
